verdict.rationale: Firebase is documented as a managed, Google-hosted backend ("without managing servers"; code is deployed "to our servers"). Nothing in the evidence shows a supported way to self-host the core product. The Local Emulator Suite runs locally, but it is documented only for building and testing, not as a production self-hosted deployment, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
